title: Section · Axes grid (multi-axis from→to)
description: Multi-axis matrix of scaling dimensions. Up to 6 axes (cards with auto-hide for empty slots). Each axis: numbered eyebrow + label, a full-width tick track (7 ticks with opacity ramp suggesting growth), from→to range labels in mono, and a short body paragraph. 3-col grid → 2-col at ≤980 → 1-col at ≤640. Used for 'how the platform scales along these axes' sections after StagesList.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-24 — axes-grid adopted as canonical scalability pattern

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: 6 axes by default. Empty axis labels auto-hide via :has(.axis-label:empty), so admins can ship 3 or 4 axes without editing markup.
Each axis has a 7-tick track with opacity ramp (0.15 → 1.00) — visually suggests 'growth along this axis' without claiming a specific measurement.
from → to is mono-typed so it reads as a spec, not a sentence.
Hover glow + halo are delegated to effect.hover-rise via data-fx="rise" on every .axis element — no local glow/halo CSS, single source of truth.
